subject: Request: latest penetration test for Hosted API + secure delivery options
messages:
From: Sam Wu <security@acornhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example.com>
Cc: J. Alvarez <jalvarez@acornhealth.com>, dylan_brooks@redwood.example.com
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request for latest pen test + transfer method for Hosted API

Hi Irene,

We're finalizing our vendor assessment for Q2 and need the most recent penetration test report that covers the Hosted API surface (production scope). Can you confirm whether Redwood has a full report (executive summary + findings) that you can share with customers? If so, what are your preferred secure transfer options? Our security team prefers either:

- a short-lived (48h) pre-signed download link behind authenticated portal, or
- SFTP with user-specific creds + IP allowlist, or
- transfer via our secure evidence exchange (we can provide a temporary agent).

Also please include:
- confirmation of the environment/scope tested (prod vs. staging)
- whether the report includes exploit steps or if redactions are applied
- a short remediation/status table (open/closed, ETA) if available

Can you send the report and a short remediation summary by EOD Monday (Apr 12)? If there are NDAs or additional approval steps, flag them and we'll route internally.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Wu
Security Engineer, Acorn Health
security@acornhealth.com

Subject: Re: Request for latest pen test + transfer method for Hosted API

Sam,

Thanks for the clear list — we can absolutely accommodate this. Short answers first: yes, we have a customer-ready pen test package (exec summary + full findings). For customer delivery we typically: 

- provide an encrypted PDF summary (we redact exploit POCs by default),
- surface a findings table with remediation status, and
- give a short remediation plan if work is ongoing.

Delivery options we support:
- Temporary portal link (48h) with SSO (preferred & audited)
- SFTP push to a customer account with IP allowlist (requires scheduling)
- Encrypted bundle via pre-shared key (for air-gapped workflows)

Two clarifications we usually confirm before release:
1) Scope: our latest test (Nov 2026) focused on the Hosted API production endpoints + auth flows (token handling, rate limiting, routing). It did not include customer-managed private deployments.
2) Redactions: exploit steps that could enable unauthenticated replays are redacted in the customer copy; we can provide a controlled POC under an NDA and explicit one-off request.

I'll loop in Soojin (security ops) for the transfer logistics and Dylan for a remediation snapshot. If you prefer the portal link, I'll open a ticket and send you the URL and one-time auth.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.example.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0182

- Expires: 2027-04-14T08:23:00-07:00 (48 hours)
- Access: SSO + one-time code (we'll email the code to the requestor)
- Files included: redwood_pen_test_summary_2026.pdf (encrypted), remediation_table_2026.csv (redacted)

Quick remediation snapshot (high level):
- Findings: 7 total (2 critical, 3 high, 2 medium)
- Critical: token leakage via misconfigured logging (patch applied, verified) — status: closed
- High: third-party lib CVE (patched; backfilled tests) — status: closed
- High: rate-limiting unset on a legacy proxy path — mitigation in prod next deploy (ETA Apr 20) — status: in-progress

If Acorn needs the full POC steps, we require a signed NDA amendment. Please confirm who should receive the one-time code and whether you want SFTP instead.
